objective: Establish admissible, supplier-neutral contracts for historical announcement semantics, analyst expectation vintages, versioned actuals, and earnings surprise without training a model.

public_source_probe.provider: Eastmoney research-report API through a direct HTTPS schema probe
public_source_probe.purpose: Determine whether report records contain immutable report-as-of forecast-year semantics; never admit probe data for training
public_source_probe.failure_policy: record failure and stop; do not bypass access controls

time_rules.announcement_without_verified_intraday_t: effective on the next verified trading session
time_rules.analyst_estimate: available only at or after its source publication timestamp
time_rules.surprise: use the last admissible consensus snapshot strictly before the actual publication timestamp
time_rules.revision: never overwrite an older vintage; append a new version linked to the superseded record
time_rules.delisted_and_historical_constituents: must be retained to prevent survivorship bias

sample_must_include: at least two revisions for the same estimate or actual
raw source lineage or vendor immutable hashes
license permission for local model research and retained derived features

completion_gate: All three import families pass schema, time, revision, coverage, and lineage checks before a challenger may be designed.
